prerequisites: Successful completion of modules to be completed in the 1st and 2nd semesters according to the study plan.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can classify different process engineering apparatuses and know their essential elements.
They are able to evaluate the efficiency and application areas of the apparatuses, as well as perform a parameter analysis.
Students know essential methods of energy-efficient heat transfer, their physical principles, and the practical implementation of the apparatuses.

syllabus_topics: Automation: Functional description, graphical representation (e.g. Visio)
Improvement methods for single-phase heat transfer
Evaporators: Heat and mass transfer on vapor bubbles, evaporation with free convection and in forced flow, mixture evaporation, finned tube evaporators, flow-through evaporators
Condensers: Film condensation, drop condensation, influence of vapor and condensate flow, mixture condensation
assessment_rules: The module examination will be passed if the module final examination is passed. In the exam, students should select and design processes and apparatuses for exemplary problems. The module is weighted by its ECTS credits (factor: 1).
